AMZN.description: The article compares two space-focused companies: AST SpaceMobile, which is building a space-based cellular network for standard smartphones, and Rocket Lab, a vertically integrated launch services provider acquiring Iridium Communications. AMZN.headline: Everyone Just Missed a Major Announcement From Meta Platforms
AMZN.description: Meta Platforms announced an upcoming cloud computing business during its Q2 earnings call, a significant development that the market largely overlooked while focusing on disappointing short-term guidance. CEO Mark Zuckerberg indicated the company is rolling out business agents and receiving premium offers for compute capacity. AMZN.headline: Why Micron Stock Was Up and Down Today
AMZN.description: Micron Technology stock experienced significant volatility on Friday, rising as much as 6.4% early in the day following positive earnings from Apple and Amazon showing continued spending on memory chips. However, the stock reversed course and closed down 4.74% as rising interest rates to 19-year highs weighed on growth stocks. While the memory supply crunch should continue supporting Micron's earnings, the author believes the valuation has become too rich.

AMZN.headline: Amazon's 14.9% Jump Lifts the Dow While Apple Drags It Back
AMZN.description: Amazon surged 14.9% after reporting strong Q2 earnings with AWS growing 37% year-over-year, adding 208 points to the Dow. Apple fell 9.4% despite solid Q3 results due to muted guidance citing chip supply constraints, subtracting 188 points from the index. The market remains driven by mega-cap tech stocks with strong AI cloud businesses, while most other stocks declined.

AMZN.headline: Is This EV Stock The Next Tesla?
AMZN.description: Rivian's stock has plummeted 80% since its 2021 IPO despite initial comparisons to Tesla. While the company expects delivery growth from 42,247 vehicles in 2025 to 62,000-67,000 in 2026 driven by its cheaper R2 SUV, it faces significant challenges including supply chain constraints, reduced EV subsidies, and intense competition. Even at its projected delivery levels, Rivian would only match Tesla's 2016 performance, making it unlikely to replicate Tesla's growth trajectory in today's crowded EV

AMZN.headline: Why Astera Labs Stock Rocketed Higher Today
AMZN.description: Astera Labs stock surged following Amazon's strong Q2 2026 earnings report, which showed AWS growing 36.7% year-over-year with AI and Chips businesses each exceeding $25 billion run rates. The rally reflects investor confidence in Astera Labs' AI connectivity solutions, though the article suggests the market may have gotten ahead of itself and recommends waiting for Astera Labs' own quarterly earnings next week.

AMZN.headline: Silver Is Down Big From Its Peak. Is Now the Time to Buy the Dip?
AMZN.description: Silver has fallen 50% from its January peak of $115/oz to $58/oz, driven by investor concerns about AI data center spending despite strong long-term demand fundamentals. McKinsey projects $7 trillion in global data center spending by 2030, and major hyperscalers continue their infrastructure investments. The article suggests this dip may present a buying opportunity for silver and related producers.

AMZN.headline: 1 Key Metric To Watch That Could Send Arm Stock Soaring
AMZN.description: Arm Holdings beat earnings expectations with 22% revenue growth to $1.29B and strong data center performance. The company's upcoming AGI CPU chip, already oversubscribed with demand more than double expectations, is positioned to drive future growth. Investors should monitor the CPU addressable market (TAM) forecasts, which have risen to $220B according to AMD's recent estimates, significantly higher than Arm's conservative $100B projection for fiscal 2031.

AMZN.headline: Everyone Wants to Build the Best AI Model. Amazon Wants Something More Valuable.
AMZN.description: Rather than competing to build the best AI model, Amazon is positioning itself as the infrastructure provider enabling AI adoption across industries. By leveraging AWS and its integrated ecosystem, Amazon can profit from AI growth regardless of which model dominates, similar to how pick-and-shovel sellers profited during gold rushes. The company plans to invest $200 billion in 2026 for AI data centers.

AMZN.headline: Stock Market Today, July 30: Amazon Soars Over 8% After Hours on Earnings Beat
AMZN.description: Amazon surged over 8% in after-hours trading on July 30, 2026, after beating Q2 earnings expectations with strong revenue growth of 20% year-over-year to $200.61 billion and robust AWS cloud service performance. The earnings report demonstrated that the company's significant AI infrastructure investments are beginning to generate returns, though concerns remain about its negative free cash flow of $7.6 billion and substantial capex spending of $173 billion for the year.

NBIS.headline: Nvidia Just Made a $2 Billion Bet on Nebius. Here's Why It Matters.
NBIS.description: Nvidia has invested $2 billion in Nebius, providing capital, hardware, and technical support to help the AI cloud company compete with larger providers. The partnership creates a closed-loop system benefiting Nvidia through both investment returns and chip sales, though Nebius faces high expectations and significant capital requirements.

NBIS.headline: Missed Out On Nebius? This Former Crypto Miner Might Be Your Second Chance.
NBIS.description: Keel Infrastructure, a former crypto miner pivoting to AI data center infrastructure, is positioned as an alternative investment opportunity for those who missed out on Nebius Group's gains. With a 2.2-gigawatt pipeline, plans to secure three hyperscaler leases by year-end, and expected revenue acceleration in 2027, Keel's colocation model minimizes capital expenditures while attracting major tech companies seeking custom chip compatibility.

NBIS.headline: Prediction: These AI Stocks Bounce Back After the Bloodbath
NBIS.description: AI stocks experienced a significant sell-off, but the article argues that the market's reaction doesn't align with underlying fundamentals. The author suggests these stocks are positioned to bounce back from the recent decline.

MKTX.headline: BRODSKY & SMITH SHAREHOLDER UPDATE: Notifying Investors of the Following Investigations: MarketAxess Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq – MKTX), CBIZ, Inc. (NYSE – CBZ), Sanara MedTech Inc. (Nasdaq – SMTI), TriCo Bancshares (Nasdaq – TCBK)
MKTX.description: Law firm Brodsky & Smith announced investigations into four major merger transactions, examining whether the boards of MarketAxess Holdings, CBIZ, Sanara MedTech, and TriCo Bancshares breached fiduciary duties by failing to conduct fair processes and potentially underpaying shareholders. The firm is seeking shareholders to discuss potential class action lawsuits.

BE.headline: Gainey McKenna & Egleston Announces A Class Action Lawsuit Has Been Filed Against Bloom Energy Corporation (BE)
BE.description: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Bloom Energy Corporation for allegedly failing to disclose that it obtained scandium through intermediaries sourcing from China. A Hunterbrook Media report on July 8, 2026 revealed the company's reliance on Chinese scandium through multiple supply chain routes, causing the stock to fall 5.7% to $254.29 per share.

BE.description: AI-driven data centers face severe power constraints as electricity demand is projected to reach 565 TWh by 2026. Bloom Energy's solid-oxide fuel cells offer a rapid deployment alternative to traditional grid upgrades, enabling installation in under two months. BE.headline: Why Did Bloom Energy Stock Rocket Higher Today?
BE.description: Bloom Energy stock surged over 25% after investors digested the company's stellar Q2 earnings report, which showed revenue exceeding $1 billion for the first time with 166% year-over-year growth. The company raised full-year guidance to $4 billion in 2026 revenue, driven by strong demand from hyperscalers and data center operators for its fuel cell power solutions for AI infrastructure.
